description: This source file contains integration tests for the Create Catalog Item endpoint in the Public API. It verifies authorization logic and the correctness of creating new catalog items, including response validation.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Contains integration test methods for creating catalog items through the API, including authorization and response validation.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Tests that a normal user token is rejected with Forbidden when attempting to create a catalog item.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that an admin user token successfully creates a catalog item and returns the expected data.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Creates and serializes a valid JSON request for creating a new catalog item.
